subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should #88204 remain as an umbrella, or should maintainers split it into separate TUI default-session, WeChat routing, background-event isolation, and session-activity ordering workstreams with explicit owners?
rationale: Source confirms several unresolved pieces, but the report crosses core Gateway/TUI behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, sessions_send routing, and product-level activity semantics that automation cannot safely collapse into one patch.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep #51028 for meaningful activity, use #93255 or a replacement for `sessions_send`, and create focused follow-ups for TUI default-session semantics plus WeChat/flood live proof.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use #88204 as the tracking issue and block code automation until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close only after linked work lands
options.body: Close this umbrella only when focused issues or PRs cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep #51028 for meaningful activity, use #93255 or a replacement for `sessions_send`, and create focused follow-ups for TUI default-session semantics plus WeChat/flood live proof.
